content.text: it repented the Lord that he had made man (Moses 8:25 it repented Noah, and his heart was pained that the Lord had made man), Gen. 6:6. Lest … the people repent when they see war, Ex. 13:17. Lord repented of the evil which he thought to do, Ex. 32:14 (2 Sam. 24:16; 1 Chr. 21:15; Jer. 26:3). he shall restore that which he took, Lev. 6:4 (Ezek. 33:15). he shall recompense his trespass, Num. 5:7. neither the son of man, that he should repent, Num. 23:19. it repented the Lord because of their groanings, Judg. 2:18. It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king, 1 Sam. 15:11 (15:35). he is not a man, that he should repent, 1 Sam. 15:29. make confession unto the Lord, Ezra 10:11. seed of Israel … confessed their sins, Neh. 9:2. I will be sorry for my sin, Ps. 38:18. Lord hath sworn, and will not repent, Ps. 110:4 (Heb. 7:21). whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy, Prov. 28:13 (Mosiah 4:10; D&C 64:12). put away the evil of your doings … cease to do evil, Isa. 1:16. unrighteous man … let him return unto the Lord, Isa. 55:7. Return ye now every man from his evil way, Jer. 35:15 (Ezek. 18:21; Jonah 3:10; Zech. 1:3; Mal. 3:7). remember thy ways, and be ashamed, Ezek. 16:61. Repent, and turn … from all your transgressions, Ezek. 18:30. repentance shall be hid from mine eyes, Hosea 13:14. Who knoweth if he will return and repent, Joel 2:14. Lord repented for this, Amos 7:3.

Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand, Matt. 3:2 (4:17). Bring forth … fruits meet for repentance, Matt. 3:8 (Luke 3:8). baptize you with water unto repentance, Matt. 3:11. come to call … sinners to repentance, Matt. 9:13 (Mark 2:17; Luke 5:32). upbraid the cities … because they repented not, Matt. 11:20. Tyre and Sidon … have repented long ago, Matt. 11:21 (Luke 10:13). Nineveh … repented at the preaching of Jonas, Matt. 12:41 (Luke 11:32). Judas … when he saw that he was condemned, repented, Matt. 27:3. preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins, Mark 1:4 (Luke 3:3; 24:47). repent ye, and believe the gospel, Mark 1:15. they went out, and preached that men should repent, Mark 6:12. except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish, Luke 13:3 (1 Ne. 14:5). joy … in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, Luke 15:7. went unto them from the dead, they will repent, Luke 16:30. saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him, Luke 17:4. Repent, and be baptized every one of you, Acts 2:38 (D&C 33:11). Repent ye therefore, and be converted, Acts 3:19. Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, Acts 5:31. Gentiles granted repentance unto life, Acts 11:18 (3 Ne. 16:13). commandeth all men every where to repent, Acts 17:30 (2 Ne. 9:23; 3 Ne. 11:32; D&C 133:16). John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, Acts 19:4. turn to God, and do works meet for repentance, Acts 26:20 (Alma 5:54). gifts and calling of God are without repentance, Rom. 11:29. godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation, 2 Cor. 7:10. foundation of repentance from dead works, Heb. 6:1. he found no place of repentance, Heb. 12:17. Lord is … longsuffering … that all should come to repentance, 2 Pet. 3:9. remove thy candlestick … except thou repent, Rev. 2:5. Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, Rev. 2:16. I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not, Rev. 2:21. men … repented not of the works of their hands, Rev. 9:20. they repented not to give him glory, Rev. 16:9.

prophets, prophesying … repent, or the great city Jerusalem must be destroyed, 1 Ne. 1:4 (1:4–20). if … they repent and come unto him, 1 Ne. 10:18 (22:28). days … prolonged … that they might repent, 2 Ne. 2:21. should persuade all men to repentance, 2 Ne. 26:27. repent and believe in his Son, 2 Ne. 30:2. except ye repent the land is cursed, Jacob 3:3. if that man repenteth not, and remaineth and dieth, Mosiah 2:38. repenteth in the sincerity of his heart, Mosiah 26:29. repented of my sins, and have been redeemed, Mosiah 27:24. he must repent or he cannot be saved, Alma 5:31. they must repent and be born again, Alma 5:49 (5:49–56; 7:13–16). who repented of their sins were baptized unto repentance, Alma 6:2. Repent ye, and prepare the way of the Lord, Alma 7:9. repent, or he will utterly destroy you, Alma 9:12. space granted … in which he might repent, Alma 12:24. many who were ordained … on account of their exceeding faith and repentance, Alma 13:10. Melchizedek … did preach repentance, Alma 13:18. he that repenteth and exerciseth faith, Alma 26:22. O that I were an angel … cry repentance, Alma 29:1. a man … if he is compelled to be humble, seeketh repentance, Alma 32:13. do not procrastinate the day of your repentance, Alma 34:33. punishment affixed, and a repentance granted, Alma 42:22. sins trouble you … unto repentance, Alma 42:29. Father to redeem them from their sins because of repentance, Hel. 5:11. repent … until ye shall have faith in Christ, Hel. 5:41. blessed are they who will repent and hearken, Hel. 12:23. none who were brought unto repentance who were not baptized, 3 Ne. 7:24. wo unto the inhabitants … except they shall repent, 3 Ne. 9:2. whoso repenteth and cometh unto me as a little child, 3 Ne. 9:22. hearken unto my words and repenteth, 3 Ne. 23:5. whoso repenteth and is baptized in my name, 3 Ne. 27:16 (D&C 18:41; 20:29; 49:13). repent of your evil doings, 3 Ne. 30:2. ye Gentiles … know the decrees of God—that ye may repent, Ether 2:11. repentance is unto them that are under condemnation, Moro. 8:24. do not repent, and Satan stirreth them up, Moro. 9:3.

they might be chastened, that they might repent, D&C 1:27. repents and does the commandments, D&C 1:32. if they repent not, until the earth is empty, D&C 5:19. Say nothing but repentance unto this generation, D&C 6:9 (11:9). gospel of repentance, and of baptism, D&C 13 (84:27). most worth … will be to declare repentance, D&C 16:6 (14:8; 15:6). great is his joy in the soul that repenteth, D&C 18:13. every man must repent or suffer, D&C 19:4. arrived unto the years of accountability … capable of repentance, D&C 20:71. angels to declare unto them repentance, D&C 29:42. having knowledge, have I not commanded to repent, D&C 29:49. sinneth and repenteth not shall be cast out, D&C 42:28. he who has repented of his sins, the same is forgiven, D&C 58:42. By this ye may know if a man repenteth … confess them and forsake them, D&C 58:43. repenteth not of his sins, and confesseth, D&C 64:12. that teach them not to understand the doctrine of repentance, D&C 68:25. if they do not repent and observe all things, D&C 98:21. redemption of mankind from the fall, and from individual sins on conditions of repentance, D&C 138:19. Savior … call them unto repentance, D&C 138:25. proclaim liberty to … all who would repent, D&C 138:31. dead who repent will be redeemed, D&C 138:58.

repent and call upon God, Moses 5:8. men … must repent, or they can in nowise inherit, Moses 6:57. Noah called … that they should repent, Moses 8:20. first principles … second, Repentance, A of F 1:4.
